snippet.title: Cup Or Die - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you survive a deadly game of beer pong?

Cup Or Die is a rogue-lite psychological horror experience where a simple bar game turns into a terrifying ritual.

Face disturbing opponents, throw with precision, and deal with unpredictable effects as every decision can either save you… or end your run.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369890/Cup_Or_Die/


🍺 About the Game

💀 A Deadly Game of Cups
• Aim carefully and choose your target
• Every cup has a different effect, some help, others ruin you

🧩 Strange Items and Passive Effects
• Collect bizarre items that twist the rules
• Build combinations that can save or sabotage your run

🎲 Unpredictable Runs
• No two runs are the same
• Effects stack, chaos escalates, and control slips away

🚪 Build Your Strategy
• Choose paths through different doors
• Adapt your playstyle with every decision

🍻 Drink or Lose Control
• Missing shots increases intoxication
• The more you drink, the harder it becomes to aim and survive

🌀 The Table Fights Back
• Cups move, shuffle, disappear, and change
• The game won’t stay fair for long

👁️ Adaptive Opponents
• Face enemies with unique mechanics and playstyles
• They don’t just play, they bend the rules

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains psychological horror elements, depictions of alcohol consumption, and stylized violence.
All content is fictional, non-graphic, and does not include explicit sexual material.
